title: First Watch

intros.text: Tap a pad as its note lands on it.
Bass next: tap as each note lands; the pads follow the pitch, low on the left.

note: 128 bars in 16 eight-bar phases (DDBDBDDBDBDBDDBD): drum phases cue the kick and snare, 6 bass phases cue the bass. The music is the player's loadout (songs/library); the mission sets only the form, the battlefield and the waves.
